<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈ 120.0455 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 120.0423 Da, which matches the calculated neutral mass within typical experimental error, making C₄H₈O₄ the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
